what: TD Synnex distributes information technology. It buys hardware, software and cloud services from vendors and sells them on to resellers and solution providers, who serve the end customers.
customers: Value-added resellers, managed service providers, system integrators and retailers worldwide.
money: PCs, mobile devices, printers and peripherals
servers, storage, networking, software and cloud
moat: Relationships with thousands of vendors and over 150,000 resellers, plus the credit and logistics that let small resellers sell enterprise technology they could not finance alone.
risks: Gross margin of 7% is extremely thin, typical of distribution
Net margin of about 1% leaves no room for error
Vendors can sell directly to large customers, bypassing distribution
opportunities: Analysts see about 46% upside from current levels
AI server and data centre hardware flowing through distribution adds volume
watch: Gross billings growth and gross margin percentage.
